title: Buying a train ticket
instructions: Lisa istasyonda bilet alıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; iki farklı tren saati ve fiyat var, dikkatli dinle.

script.speaker: clerk
script.text: Good afternoon. How can I help you?

script.speaker: lisa
script.text: Hello. I'd like a ticket to Oxford, please.

script.speaker: lisa
script.text: Return, please. I'm coming back tomorrow evening.

script.speaker: clerk
script.text: OK. When do you want to travel?

script.speaker: lisa
script.text: Now, if possible. What time is the next train?

script.speaker: clerk
script.text: The next train is at ten past two, but it's very busy. There's another train at twenty to three.

script.speaker: lisa
script.text: I'll take the ten past two train. How much is the ticket?

script.speaker: clerk
script.text: A return ticket is twenty-four pounds.

script.speaker: clerk
script.text: Platform four. It's on the left, next to the café.

script.speaker: clerk
script.text: You're welcome. Have a nice trip!

questions.prompt: What kind of ticket does Lisa buy?
questions.feedback: Gidiş-dönüş (return) istiyor çünkü yarın akşam geri dönecek.
İki tren var: 2:10 ve 2:40 (twenty to three). Lisa 2:10 trenini (ten past two) seçiyor.
questions.evidence: I'll take the ten past two train.

questions.feedback: Gidiş-dönüş bileti yirmi dört pound (twenty-four pounds).
questions.evidence: A return ticket is twenty-four pounds.

options: on the right, next to the ticket office
on the left, next to the café
on the left, next to the shop
on the right, next to the café
questions.feedback: Peron solda (on the left) ve kafenin yanında (next to the café). İki bilginin de doğru olması gerekiyor.
questions.evidence: It's on the left, next to the café.
